release_notes: Build 64 adds direct Website visibility controls for every synced quiz: Go live now, Follow schedule and Take offline.
Taking a quiz offline switches the Cloudflare website copy to draft without deleting its questions, images, metadata or stored release time.
Go live now makes the selected quiz publicly playable immediately; Follow schedule returns it to the linked local release time and shows it as Upcoming when that time is in the future.

Normal website content/question resyncs now preserve an existing quiz's website visibility and publish time, preventing Sync scheduled or Autopilot from silently undoing a manual live/offline decision.
The tracker Worker exposes an authenticated status-only PATCH endpoint, so visibility changes do not re-upload or replace quiz questions.
Website visibility actions require confirmation and refresh/reselect the changed quiz after Cloudflare confirms the update.
